slides.title: Slide 5: What is AI Automation?
slides.narration:
Can an **AI** complete a task entirely on its own?
Yes, this is called automation.
**AI** automation means the **AI** takes over a repetitive task completely.
It performs the task without human intervention.

slides.title: Slide 6: Example: Email Sorting with AI
slides.narration:
Let us look at an example.
Imagine an **AI** system that sorts customer support emails.
It automatically categorizes emails into 'Billing' or 'Technical Issue'.
This **AI** does the sorting task independently.
Think about other repetitive tasks that **AI** could do.

slides.title: Slide 7: What is AI Augmentation?
slides.narration:
How can **AI** help us do our jobs better or faster?
This is called augmentation.
**AI** augmentation means **AI** acts as a partner.
It helps a human perform their job more effectively.

slides.title: Slide 8: Example: Marketing Brainstorming with AI
slides.narration:
Let us see a practical example.
A marketing professional needs 20 different headlines for an ad campaign.
They use an **AI** tool to brainstorm these ideas.
The **AI** generates many options quickly.
The human then selects and refines the best headlines.
Consider how **AI** can be your creative partner.

slides.title: Slide 9: Comparing Automation and Augmentation
slides.narration:
What is the main difference between these two approaches?
Automation replaces human effort for specific tasks.
Augmentation assists and enhances human capabilities.
Automation focuses on efficiency in repetitive tasks.
Augmentation focuses on boosting human creativity and speed.
Which approach suits your current task best?

slides.title: Slide 10: Benefits of Augmentation
slides.narration:
Augmentation often has the biggest immediate impact.
It allows humans to focus on complex and creative work.
**AI** handles the routine or generates initial ideas.
This leads to greater innovation and job satisfaction.
We combine human intelligence with **AI**'s speed.

slides.title: Slide 11: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned in this tutorial.
First, **AI** automation means **AI** completes tasks independently.
Next, **AI** augmentation means **AI** partners with humans to enhance their work.
Third, augmentation often provides significant immediate benefits.
Finally, choosing the right approach depends on the specific task at hand.

slides.title: Slide 12: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now, let us do a small activity.
Think of a task you do regularly at work or home.
Consider how **AI** could either automate or augment this task.
Write down one example for automation and one for augmentation.
Explain why you chose each approach.
